name: Seal Bay Resort
accommodation: Caravans, beachfront hot-tub lodges, group houses and a touring park
dogs: Dog Adventure Park on site; check pet policy
beachAccess: About a mile of private beachfront in Selsey
confirmedFeatures: Indoor and outdoor pools, gym, bowling, spa, restaurants, bars, entertainment
overview: A large resort in Selsey with around a mile of private beachfront, roughly 2.7 miles from Bracklesham Bay. It offers caravans, hot-tub lodges, group houses and touring pitches, with pools, restaurants and evening entertainment.
surfTripFit: A short drive from Bracklesham and the Witterings, with plenty to occupy non-surfers.
